runtime_scope: CPython3.12.3/Linux; source3.12/3.13 family on Windows. A disclosed platform variant, not Windows or3.13 reproduction. Exact source patch unspecified.
observation: Original output reached hang after direct loop.stop returned; process remained alive until the guard. This is consistent with the reported low-level cross-thread wakeup/lifetime symptom, without proving its cause.
measurement_limits: PTY receive times include launch/read/poll delays and are not precise code-event or selector timing. Stdout and stderr were merged in owned PTY; console buffering differs from pipes. The printed hang label does not prove an infinite hang, blocked stop caller, background-thread stack, CPU cost or wakeup failure.
cleanup_scope: Saved supervisor sends group SIGTERM, waits and probes group absence; exit-15 is forced termination, not clean completion. No independent descendant/thread inventory, FD ownership or all-group cleanup proof; raw monotonic endpoint values not retained.
